domestic_evidence: Screener.in (consolidated, sourced from BSE/NSE filings): "Dec 2025 Sales 9,686" and "TTM Sales 11,160" Rs crore, with quarterly sales "Sep 2026 3,089" and "YoY Sales growth +27%" — i.e. large ongoing domestic Indian turnover (GST-registered operations, listed entity). Note: the annual report's explicit export-vs-domestic revenue split was not retrievable (schaeffler.co.in returned HTTP 403), so the domestic/export split in rupees is null.
note: Legal entity is Schaeffler India Limited (formerly FAG Bearings India Limited) — same company, name changed; not a separate supplier. Declared HS 848220 is a valid subheading for tapered roller bearings and matches actual records (HS 84822013 wheel-set bearing seen on BOL 1142165), so no HS correction needed; the company also ships 84821020 and 84823000. Export shipments are real and dated, but the visible counterparties are all Schaeffler group affiliates (Germany, USA, Indonesia, China) — i.e. intra-group transfers rather than third-party sales; the free view does not show non-affiliate export buyers. Industry claim 'metallurgy and mining' is inaccurate — the company is a bearings/automotive and industrial components manufacturer. Revenue: consolidated FY2025 sales Rs 9,686 crore (Screener.in); export share of revenue: null (not public in retrieved sources).
